Sylas|mid.identity: Magic damage fighter-mage who steals ultimates. Chain Lash (Q) crosses his chains to slow, then explode, Kingslayer (W) leaps onto a target and heals him more when he's low, Abscond / Abduct (E) dashes, then throws a chain that pulls him to the enemy and stuns them, and Hijack (R) steals an enemy champion's ultimate. After every ability, his next attack hits in an area (passive).
Sylas|mid.playstyle: In mid, Sylas is a short-range fighter who wins trades thanks to W's healing and roams with E. His stolen ultimate depends on the enemy comp.
Sylas|mid.early_game: Farm with Q and your passive. Trade with E → chain (stun) → Q → W when your opponent steps up. Against long-range mages, farm and wait for your jungler.
Sylas|mid.level_2: Kingslayer (W). A leap and a heal: E → W is a good short trade.
Sylas|mid.level_3: Chain Lash (Q). Full kit: E → chain → Q → W → attacks (passive).
Sylas|mid.level_6: Hijack: steal the most useful ultimate on the enemy team (engage, area, execute, healing). Hold it for the deciding moment if it's a teamfight ultimate.
power_spikes: Mid game: playmaking with the stolen ultimate.
Sylas|mid.lane_plan: Farm, trade briefly with W and roam with E after level 6. The mid role quest (faster recall) makes your roams more profitable. Against long-range mages, play for farm and your jungler.
Sylas|mid.trading: Short trade: E → chain → W. All-in: E → Q → W → stolen R. Give up on it against mages who stop you (Vex) or poke you from out of range.
threats: Vex: your hardest matchup (her passive stops your dashes).
Enemy comps with no interesting ultimate to steal.
mistakes: Stealing an ultimate at random without looking at the enemy comp.
Using W too early, when you don't need the heal.
Engaging with E against a mage who can interrupt you.

matchup_notes.Ahri: Dodge her Charm with E and steal her ultimate to chase her.
matchup_notes.Zed: W heals you through his burst; steal his ultimate.
matchup_notes.Viktor: Engage when his Gravity Field is on cooldown.
matchup_notes.Vex: Her passive interrupts your E: farm and roam.
matchup_notes.Hwei: He pokes you: play around your jungler.

Sylas|mid.mid_game: Roams and playmaking with the stolen ultimate around objectives.
Sylas|mid.late_game: Use the stolen ultimate at the right moment, then W to survive.
Sylas|mid.ahead: Roam, take objectives and force fights.
Sylas|mid.behind: Farm and look for a decisive stolen ultimate.
Sylas|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to win short trades thanks to W and turn teamfights with the stolen ultimate.
Sylas|mid.final_tip: Before stealing an ultimate, look at the whole enemy comp: pick the one that will have the most impact.
